description: Where the store's items come from (ADR-0038, docs/STORE.md section 5.2). Every source is searched by default, in one place in the store, and each can be switched off there; the only exception is `anthropic`, which stays off until the terms for listing its catalogues in a third-party app are read (`terms: unverified`). Labels are in boopis's words: the engine's name never appears in one (ADR-0031). `default_tier` is the lowest tier the source's own review supports; a source's own marks can raise single items to `verified`, and only boopis's own list yields `recommended`.

sources.label: Recommended by boopis
sources.description: boopis's own list: items a person at boopis checked against their publisher's sources and pinned. The front page of the store. Compiled into the app; a signed hosted index comes later.

sources.label: From the engine's store
sources.description: The plugins the engine's own store lists, every tier, read through the engine. These are Python that runs inside the engine, in every session.
sources.note: The engine marks entries official, verified or community. Official and verified entries show as "Verified by its source"; community entries are "Not reviewed".

sources.label: Skills from the engine's hub
sources.description: The engine's skills hub: its trusted repositories, its hosted index and the other places it reads, searched through the engine.
sources.note: The hub's trusted repositories show as "Verified by its source"; everything else is "Not reviewed".

sources.label: Anthropic's catalogues
sources.description: The plugins in Anthropic's official marketplace and the skills in Anthropic's skills repository, each pinned at a commit boopis resolves.
sources.note: Off until the terms that apply to listing these catalogues in another app are read (the owner's brief, decision 7): they could not be checked on 2026-11-21. Switching it on is the user's choice, and each item still shows its own licence.

sources.label: The MCP Registry
sources.description: The official registry of MCP servers (a preview service). Names are proven to belong to their publisher; the servers are not reviewed. Synced into the local cache about hourly and searched locally.
sources.note: Deleted entries are dropped; deprecated ones are flagged. Egress and tools are shown as not known.

sources.label: GitHub
sources.description: Skill and plugin repositories on GitHub. Searched in boopis's cached lists; "add from a GitHub URL" resolves any single repository. Live GitHub search turns on only when boopis has a GitHub sign-in, because unauthenticated limits are low.

sources.label: Added by you
sources.description: Any plugin marketplace address or git repository you add. Nothing here until you add one; items are "Not reviewed".

sources.label: From your computer
sources.description: A folder or file you pick: a skill folder, a plugin or mod folder, an MCP bundle. Items are "Not reviewed".
